content.value: Fused quartz transmits 85% of the thermal radiation at 1700K in the wavelength band (17) $\lambda _ { 1 } = 0 . 2$ to $\lambda _ { 2 } = 3$ μm and is opaque to the radiation outside this range. If a blackbody radiation source at 1700K is placed in front of this fused quartz sheet, what is the rate of energy transmitted through a 0.1 sq. m area of the quartz sheet?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
